context: Fix the explicit raw_config fallback at the boundary selected by the result schema/environment/exporter contract; then add a behavior-driven sentinel sweep with stable secret tokens and an allowlist only for documented, non-secret identifiers. Keep anonymize=False path identity behavior while guaranteeing credential absence.
description: The shipped result path still allows an explicit BenchmarkResults.platform_raw_config to bypass structural filtering when ResultExporter(anonymize=False) is used, which is the documented MCP path. A driven origin/develop export contained RAW_PASSWORD and RAW_API verbatim. Make every public result export redact credential material at the raw-config boundary while preserving non-secret tuning/config values. Use this PR to add the permanent L3 sentinel invariant test: enumerate all 47 registered adapters with sentinel credentials where constructible, drive the normalized metadata, JSON, and companion/export chokepoints, and fail closed for any unexpected platform that cannot be constructed on the host. Record the two macOS ODBC blockers as explicit test diagnostics rather than silently shrinking coverage. Do not introduce SecretStr or the unapproved four-layer design.

preserves.behavior: all unrelated worktree content and the documented MCP local-consumer contract
